Per CREDIT_IS_NOT_LINEAGE_V1 and FAMILY_IDENTITY_GUARD_V1, the contributor's own 'extends: outcome-controls-entry-ladder' declaration and citation of family-generative-falsification in their YAML do not bind this work into that occupied family, since the actual delivered result (a rhyme/versification negative control) is a substantively different mechanism test from the credited Cardan table-and-grille (M5a/M5b) experiment. families_added.scope: A new bounded diagnostic control in the generative-falsification research area: measures line-structured metrics (word-final char entropy, line-final word final-char entropy, line-initial first-char entropy, top-5 line-final word rhyme concentration) across the pinned ZL3b corpus's real lines, a newly added rhymed-verse control (Shakespeare's Sonnets, PG 1041), and existing Culpeper/Alice prose pseudo-line baselines, showing that rhyme (even at its most ending-constrained, 3.50 bits) does not approach the manuscript's every-word final-char entropy (2.59 bits), excluding versification as the mechanism behind the residual word-ending discipline, plus a side finding that the manuscript's line-final position is less constrained than its average word (2.99 vs 2.59), opposite of rhyme.
